title: Kirschmer's equation for head loss through a bar rack

symbols.definition: Bar shape factor which is assigned value of 2.42 for sharp edged rectangular bar, 1.83 for rectangular bar with semicircle upstream, 1.79 for circular, and 1.67 for rectangular bar with both u/s and d/s face as semi-circular
Maximum width of bar facing the flow, m
Minimum clear spacing between bars, m
Velocity head of flow approaching rack, m
Angle of inclination of rack with the horizontal

applicability: Head loss through a bar rack, as the alternative to equation (5.1).
notes: Printed with a capital S in Sin theta; retained as printed and not corrected.
The printed symbol list writes hv without a subscript while the formula prints h with subscript v.
